result.summary:
Independent re-gate of lib/letflow/design/iss0703-oidc-verifier-exception-handling.md, rework iteration 1. Read the current doc directly (not CODE-DESIGNER's summary) and re-verified all 6 of step-02's original acceptance_criteria from scratch, plus confirmed the two AC5 gaps named in the prior FAIL (handoffs/WF03-ISS0703-20260917/step-02b-code-design-validator.json) are actually fixed.

Gap 1 (Section 4): the literal, pasteable `Logger.warning("Letflow.Oidc.TokenVerifier.Oidcc crashed verifying a bearer token kind=#{kind} message=#{message}")` statement is gone. Section 4 (current lines 115-130) is now prose-only describing the log message's content (module+function name, then kind/message fields) with no fenced code block. Confirmed via grep for fenced blocks (only 3 remain in the whole doc: lines 64-66, 101-106, 134-140) -- none in Section 4.

Gap 2 (Section 5): the full `def ... rescue ... catch ... end` skeleton in real Elixir syntax is gone. Section 5's only remaining fenced block (lines 134-140) is the legitimate `@impl`/`@spec`/def-head signature ending at `when is_binary(raw_token)` -- no rescue/catch/end clauses in code form. Clause-placement detail is now stated in prose only (current lines 147-155), redundant with Section 2 as intended, not in code syntax.

Verified via `git show 3949b420` that the diff touched only these two spots -- no other section's substance changed.

All 6 original ACs re-confirmed independently against current doc content:
1. Rescue/catch boundary + exact {:error, reason} shape: Section 2 (both oidcc calls, lines 21-60) + Section 3 (`{:verifier_crashed, %{kind: :error|:exit|:throw, message: String.t()}}`, lines 62-95) -- present and precise.
2. Both Oidcc.Token.validate_jwt/3 and Oidcc.ClientContext.from_configuration_worker/4 covered in one boundary with justification: Section 2, lines 26-38 -- present.
3. Corrected moduledoc text: Section 6, lines 157-183 -- present, accurate 'never raises' claim.
4. TEST-DESIGNER guidance (real Oidcc adapter, not TokenVerifierDouble, unit+integration, fail-then-pass): Section 7, lines 185-230 -- present and precise.
5. No implementation code: now satisfied -- only 3 fenced blocks remain, all legitimate (Section 3's @type shape, Section 3's unmodified auth_pipeline.ex quote offered as evidence, Section 5's @spec/def-head signature). No literal statements, no rescue/catch/end skeletons.
6. No auth_pipeline.ex changes proposed absent a real gap: Section 3 (lines 97-113) and Section 8 (lines 237-239) both explicitly state no gap was found and no change is proposed -- confirmed consistent, nothing silently altered.

PASS -- both previously-named gaps are fixed, no regression elsewhere, all 6 ACs hold.
